import z3
import time

n = 19
min_edges = 25
max_colors = 5
girth_min = 5  # no cycles of length 3 or 4

# We'll encode adjacency matrix
edges = {}
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(i+1, n):
        edges[(i,j)] = z3.Bool(f"e_{i}_{j}")

s = z3.Solver()

# Count edges
edge_sum = sum([z3.If(edges[(i,j)], 1, 0) for (i,j) in edges])
s.add(edge_sum >= min_edges)

# Girth constraint: no cycles of length 3
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(i+1, n):
        for k in range(j+1, n):
            s.add(z3.Not(z3.And(edges[(i,j)], edges[(j,k)], edges[(i,k)])))

# Girth constraint: no cycles of length 4
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(i+1, n):
        for k in range(j+1, n):
            for l in range(k+1, n):
                # cycle i-j-k-l-i or i-k-j-l-i or i-j-l-k-i
                s.add(z3.Not(z3.And(edges[(i,j)], edges[(j,k)], edges[(k,l)], edges[(i,l)])))
                s.add(z3.Not(z3.And(edges[(i,k)], edges[(k,j)], edges[(j,l)], edges[(i,l)])))
                s.add(z3.Not(z3.And(edges[(i,j)], edges[(j,l)], edges[(l,k)], edges[(i,k)])))

# Colorability: at most 5 colors
# Each vertex has a color (0-4)
colors = [z3.Int(f"c_{i}") for i in range(n)]
for i in range(n):
    s.add(colors[i] >= 0, colors[i] < max_colors)

# Adjacent vertices must have different colors
for (i,j) in edges:
    s.add(z3.Implies(edges[(i,j)], colors[i] != colors[j]))

print("Setting up constraints done. Solving...")
start = time.time()
result = s.check()
print(f"Result: {result}, time: {time.time()-start:.1f}s")

if result == z3.sat:
    model = s.model()
    edge_list = []
    for (i,j), b in edges.items():
        if model.evaluate(b, model_completion=True):
            edge_list.append((i,j))
    print(f"Number of edges: {len(edge_list)}")
    print("Edges:", edge_list)
    
    # Check coloring
    col = [model.evaluate(colors[i]).as_long() for i in range(n)]
    print("Colors:", col)

import z3
import time

n = 19
min_edges = 25
max_colors = 5

# Helper to get edge variable
edge_vars = {}
def get_edge(i, j):
    if (i, j) in edge_vars:
        return edge_vars[(i, j)]
    if (j, i) in edge_vars:
        return edge_vars[(j, i)]
    raise KeyError(f"No edge for {i}, {j}")

for i in range(n):
    for j in range(i+1, n):
        edge_vars[(i, j)] = z3.Bool(f"e_{i}_{j}")

s = z3.Solver()
s.set("timeout", 300000)  # 5 min timeout in ms

# Count edges
edge_sum = sum([z3.If(edge_vars[(i,j)], 1, 0) for (i,j) in edge_vars])
s.add(edge_sum >= min_edges)

print("Adding triangle constraints...")
# No cycles of length 3
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(i+1, n):
        for k in range(j+1, n):
            s.add(z3.Not(z3.And(get_edge(i,j), get_edge(j,k), get_edge(i,k))))

print("Adding 4-cycle constraints...")
# No cycles of length 4
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(i+1, n):
        for k in range(j+1, n):
            for l in range(k+1, n):
                # All possible 4-cycles on these vertices:
                # i-j-k-l-i
                s.add(z3.Not(z3.And(get_edge(i,j), get_edge(j,k), get_edge(k,l), get_edge(i,l))))
                # i-k-j-l-i
                s.add(z3.Not(z3.And(get_edge(i,k), get_edge(k,j), get_edge(j,l), get_edge(i,l))))
                # i-j-l-k-i
                s.add(z3.Not(z3.And(get_edge(i,j), get_edge(j,l), get_edge(l,k), get_edge(i,k))))

print("Adding coloring constraints...")
# Colorability: at most 5 colors
colors = [z3.Int(f"c_{i}") for i in range(n)]
for i in range(n):
    s.add(colors[i] >= 0, colors[i] < max_colors)

# Adjacent vertices must have different colors

    s.add(z3.Implies(edge_vars[(i,j)], colors[i] != colors[j]))
